datasets.help: Per data row its columns, each column of a row described individually under keys.

value.label: V
value.title: Value column (numeric)
value.help: The value column of the row (slot V), numeric and required. Without it the row stays but is not plotted. Empty until one is chosen.

group.label: G1
group.title: 1st grouping (categorical)
group.help: The first grouping of the row (slot G1), optional; it splits the row into groups, one per group value. Empty until one is chosen.

group2.label: G2
group2.title: 2nd grouping — sub-groups within G1
group2.help: The second grouping of the row (slot G2), optional; it splits further within the first grouping. Empty until one is chosen.

group3.label: G3
group3.title: 3rd grouping — sub-groups within G2
group3.help: The third grouping of the row (slot G3), optional; it splits further within the second grouping. Empty until one is chosen.

confLevel.help: The confidence level in percent, greater than 0 and less than 100 (for example 95). It determines the confidence intervals in the statistics table.

showStats.help: Show or hide the statistics per group below the chart.

stats.help: Per plotted group its statistics and confidence intervals, structured like modules.shared.types.SeriesStats; null while nothing can be computed.

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: value, group, group2, group3.

groups.help: The point groups built from the data rows (name and values), or an object with "error" and "params" when no groups can be built.
